findings.one_line: The proposed flagship is a fixed finite, complete within- and cross-regime orientation calculus, but the proved kernel is only global target-residual enumeration; the calculus and its paired local-extension proof remain explicitly open.

Position the headline against Li--Jaber--Bareinboim (NeurIPS 2023) on S-PAG/S-FCI: explain that its selection-diagram domain shifts expressly assume no selection bias, and why it neither subsumes nor supplies the selected common-basal recovery map here.
